name: twelve_signals
strategy_text: Each month the fund ranks every US stock on twelve published signals, equally weighted: operating profitability, slow growth in net operating assets, 12-month momentum, low net equity issuance, low bankruptcy risk, book-to-market, earnings surprise, low share issuance, slow total asset growth, a quality score, low stock-specific volatility and gross profitability. It buys the best-ranked stocks and shorts the worst-ranked, keeping the book dollar, beta and sector neutral.
